me first say that I am aware that the NHS is about to collapse and that NHS staff are paid extremely poorly.

But what I experienced here was bad.

I had worrying symptoms that were disrupting my normal life for a long period of time, and I saw a doctor here multiple times. Multiple times I was told that it is probably just anxiety, that it is stress, or that it's all in my head. Denied any examination and possible treatment. Several months later I have gone through my records and it turned out none of my complaints about pain and symptoms have been noted.

Now I went back to my country, and I got seen by several doctors, got quickly diagnosed and will have surgery to deal with the problem. When I told them about what I experienced in England, they all shook their heads and asked: why would I be treated like that and why would medical professionals leave my issue undiagnosed and untreated, eventually getting worse so much so that now a surgery is necessary?

I understand NHS is struggling, but why could you not tell me to seek private care? Why could you not log my symptoms, why could you not acknowledge my symptoms? Why could you not tell me that treatment would be needed but the waiting time is long? Why were you not able to treat me like human being? Instead you subjected me to vile gaslighting. Made me feel like I'm crazy. At one point I even believed you and felt guilty for wasting your precious time! This took a huge hit at my mental health. Furthermore, I am now in much worse physical health due to the untreated problem (even though surgery will improve it).

How can you behave like that, and how can you treat people like that? What is wrong with you? If you treat patients like that, why are you a doctor?

I get it that the medical system is overwhelmed. But why is your solution to gaslight and convince a portion of patients that they're not sick, when in fact they are? Why lie to them? They could seek treatment elsewhere. They should be made aware of their condition. What you're doing is absolutely evil.

I would stay away from this place.
